article.title: Why Missing Data Is Sometimes a Signal, Not Just a Problem
article.why: Distinguish informative missingness from unstable data-pipeline failures.

paragraphs.en:
Missing data is often treated as a cleaning problem: fill the blank, drop the row, or add an imputed value. In customer modeling, however, the fact that a value is missing can itself contain information. The challenge is deciding whether that information reflects meaningful customer behavior or merely a broken data process.

Imagine a feature measuring mobile-app activity. Some customers have no value because they never registered for the app. Missingness then reveals something about channel adoption. A missing indicator may help the model distinguish app users from nonusers even before considering the amount of activity. Similarly, a missing credit-card transaction feature may indicate that the customer does not hold or use that card.

This is called informative missingness: the probability that a value is missing is related to customer characteristics or the outcome of interest. Simply replacing every missing value with zero can erase the distinction between ‘no activity because the customer does not use the service’ and ‘activity was measured and the amount was zero.’ Creating an explicit missing indicator can preserve that information.

But missingness can be dangerous. Suppose a source system fails for three days and thousands of active customers suddenly have blank values. A model trained when missingness meant ‘nonuser’ may now interpret a technical outage as a customer characteristic. Predictions can shift dramatically even though customer behavior has not changed.

The same problem appears when data collection changes. A field may be optional in one year and mandatory in the next. A business unit may start sending data later than others. A new application version may alter logging. In each case, missingness patterns change for operational reasons rather than because customers changed.

Analysts should therefore profile missingness by time, segment, source system, and outcome. Useful questions include: What percentage is missing? Has that rate changed? Is missingness concentrated in a particular company or channel? Does the meaning of missing remain stable between training and production? Can the feature be calculated consistently before the prediction date?

Model evaluation should also test alternatives. Compare an imputed feature alone with an imputed feature plus a missing indicator. Examine out-of-time performance rather than relying only on a random split. If the missing indicator becomes one of the strongest predictors, investigate why before celebrating. It may reflect a real behavioral pattern, but it may also expose leakage, a process artifact, or a source-system boundary.

Documentation is essential. For each important feature, define what null means, whether zero is different from null, which systems produce the field, and what fallback occurs when data are late. Monitoring should alert the team when missing rates move outside an expected range.

Missing data is therefore neither automatically useless nor automatically valuable. It is a signal only when its mechanism is understood and sufficiently stable. Treating missingness as a first-class data property—rather than an inconvenience to hide—can improve both predictive performance and production reliability.
paragraphs.zh:
Missing data 不只是清理問題；「為什麼缺失」本身有時包含顧客資訊。例如 app activity 缺失可能代表根本未註冊 app，card transaction 缺失可能代表未持有或未使用該卡。這類 informative missingness 可透過 missing indicator 保留。

但若缺失來自 source system outage、資料收集規則改變或 logging 變更，模型可能把技術問題誤認成顧客特徵。因此要按時間、segment、source、outcome 監控 missing rate，並確認 null 與 zero 的 business meaning。若 missing indicator 突然成為最強 predictor，也應先調查 leakage 或 process artifact。Missingness 只有在機制可理解且跨期穩定時，才是可信的 signal。
paragraphs.ja:
missing dataは単なるcleaning対象ではなく、欠損している事実自体が情報になる場合があります。app activityの欠損が未登録を示すならchannel adoptionのsignalです。zeroとnullを同じ値で埋めると、この違いを消す可能性があります。

一方、source system outageや収集rule変更で欠損が増えれば、modelはtechnical failureを顧客特性と誤認します。そのためtime、segment、source別にmissing rateを監視し、nullのbusiness meaning、zeroとの差、prediction時点での取得可能性を定義します。missing indicatorが強いpredictorになった場合も、behavioral signalなのかleakage/process artifactなのかを調査します。欠損はmechanismが理解でき、期間をまたいで安定しているときに初めて信頼できるsignalになります。

vocabulary.usage: The feature may show informative missingness.
The pattern may be a process artifact.
Treat missingness as a first-class property.

business.term: A null value is not necessarily equivalent to zero.
business.explanation: 提醒確認缺失與實際零值的業務語義。
